descriptions.preferred: Except for its intense brilliant yellow or orange fall color, 'Ichigyo¯ji' re- - sembles the crimson-leaved 'Osakazuki'. During summer, the large seven-lobed leaves are a pleasant green. They are broadly ovate and sharppointed, with slightly toothed edges. The lobes are joined about halfway to the base. sources.title: 一行寺Acer Palmatum 'Ichigyoji'
sources.description: 一行寺是一款非常稀少的枫树品种，在市面上不常见。 春天金黄色，夏季会返绿，秋天一棵树上会出现金色、 橙色和猩红色。 叶型和红灯笼很像，成年树高约 3-4 米。

rhs.description: A large, bushy shrub, or small spreading tree, with a rounded head to around 6m tall and wide. The large, 7-lobed green leaves, up to 15cm across, turn brilliant orange and yellow in autumn. Small red flowers borne in clusters in spring are followed by red fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants, Rock Garden, Architectural, Cottage/Informal Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this amoenum group have large, palm-shaped leaves with finely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 除了极其鲜亮的黄色或橙色秋叶外，'Ichigyo¯ji' 与红叶品种 'Osakazuki' 很相似。 夏季时，大型 7 裂叶呈悦目的绿色。 裂片宽卵形，先端尖锐，边缘略具锯齿。 裂片约在接近叶基一半处相连。 树形直立而开展，成熟后形成圆头状，树高可达 23 英尺（7 米）。 日本作者建议将 'Ichigyo¯ji' 与 'Osakazuki' 相邻种植，以便充分欣赏其秋季绚烂色彩。 'Ichigyo¯ji' 的名称源自一座寺庙。

care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 大型丛生灌木或开展型小乔木，树冠圆整，高宽均可达约 6 米。 叶片较大，7 裂，绿色，叶幅可达 15 厘米，秋季转为明亮的橙色和黄色。 春季开簇生小型红花，之后结红色果实。

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 amoenum 类群中的 Acer 品种具有大型掌状叶，叶缘具细锯齿。
